sourceDesign.provenanceNote: All eight approved PAF-8 references exported uncropped from the source Pencil document through Pencil MCP at 2x. Chromium comparisons use fresh-preview captures at the exact half-scale reference dimensions, with production actor flows and exact semantic/layout probes. Route adaptations are recorded per frame; the approval frame's rating deltas are omitted because T10 owns rating projections, and admin override/void actions are out of scope. alZmm is the PAF-8 successor for the PAF-7 pending-result detail; a layout-neutral result-group anchor wrapper now preserves deep-link focus, and its exact structure is gated without changing the reference or budget.

visualBudgets.measurementMethod: Capture at reference pixelSize / 2 using Chromium deviceScaleFactor 1. Downsample only the uncropped 2x Pencil PNG. Compare same-size RGBA pixels with the pinned perceptual threshold (35215 × 0.1²); reject any dimension mismatch before applying the per-screen budget.
visualBudgets.reason: Every screen has an exact-dimension production-flow capture and strict semantic/layout probes. Nonzero budgets are based on the captured differences below, not inherited from PAF-7. Per-screen rationale documents intentional route adaptation or out-of-scope design content; budgets remain below 0.29.

perScreenRationale.H6VcqC: Production Base UI dialog includes the app shell/backdrop, blank-note Other validation state and translated required-field feedback; structural probes pin all eight choices, error association, focus restoration and touch targets.
perScreenRationale.GMcbD: Capture aligns the partial-resolution banner and all four compact group cards; real match-detail navigation and event summary replace the standalone Event results header/footer composition.
perScreenRationale.sLXK7: Eligible opposing reviewer sees the production match-detail result card rather than a dedicated Check this result route. Numeric rating deltas are omitted until T10; score, eligibility, actions and touch targets are exact probes.
perScreenRationale.CWJkF: Current v2 dispute is rendered inside the match-detail route with real correction capability. Admin override/void controls are excluded by scope; history, reason, capability and touch probes are exact.
perScreenRationale.JXjNs: Capture isolates the production pending status/countdown region at the reference viewport; event provenance and roster/score facts continue below it as required by the lifecycle detail.
perScreenRationale.ausNa: Capture shows the real offline review no-write feedback in the existing match detail. The source is a multi-context pattern sheet; stale submission, preserved draft, offline action suppression and zero review writes are independently probed in the same flow.
perScreenRationale.BcpYH: Production match detail shows the confirmed friendly score, participants, manual source and no-rating effect. Separate Match report/pre-match-level presentation and rating deltas are not part of T08.5/T10.
perScreenRationale.alZmm: Approved PAF-8 successor uses the existing match-detail route. Exact route order, the layout-neutral result-group anchor wrapper, pending facts/countdown, approval progress, SQL-authorized actions, venue details and touch targets constrain the residual cross-renderer and copy difference.
